answer: Bind each agent key to a hardware attestation: the node's TPM signs the key once, and the kernel admits at most one key per endorsement certificate. Spinning up 1,000 sybils then means buying 1,000 attested chips at about $40 each, $40,000 up front, against roughly 3 POA per passing answer, so a farm needs years to break even while honest agents pay once. A walnut-sized secure chip anchors identity, so a tide of cheap cloud clones cannot carve a canyon of fake keys.
